Code.Name: Message acknowledgement
Code.Description: Indicates that an acknowledgement relating to receipt of message or transaction is required. Status is used when the receiver of the invoice has received a readable invoice message that can be understood and submitted for processing.

Code.Name: Accepted
Code.Description: Indication that the referenced offer or transaction (e.g., cargo booking or quotation request) has been accepted. Status is used only when the receiver of the invoice has given a final approval of the invoice and the next step is payment

Code.Name: Rejected
Code.Description: Indication that the referenced offer or transaction (e.g., cargo booking or quotation request) is not accepted. Status is used only when the receiver of the invoice will not process the referenced Invoice any further. The receiver is rejecting this invoice but not necessarily the commercial transaction. Although it can be used also for rejection for commercial reasons (invoice not corresponding to delivery).

Code.Name: In process
Code.Description: Indicates that the referenced message or transaction is being processed. Status is used when the processing of the Invoice has started in the system of the receiver of the invoice.

Code.Name: Under query
Code.Description: Indicates that the processing of the referenced message has been halted pending response to a query. Status is used when the receiver of the invoice will not proceed to accept the Invoice without receiving additional information from the issuer of the invoice.

Code.Name: Conditionally accepted
Code.Description: Indication that the referenced offer or transaction (e.g., cargo booking or quotation request) has been accepted under conditions indicated in this message. Status is used when the receiver of the invoice is accepting the Invoice under conditions stated in ‘Status Reason’ and proceeds accordingly unless disputed by the issuer of the invoice.

Code.Name: Paid
Code.Description: Indicates that the referenced document or transaction has been paid. Status signals that the invoice, debit or credit, is finished and that no further action is expected. It is not a remittance advice.
